description: This PHP source file implements a REST API endpoint class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionAPI' for managing US tax exemption details of employees in the OrangeHRM system. It supports retrieving and updating tax exemption data through GET and PUT requests, and interacts with the service layer 'EmpUsTaxExemptionService'. The class includes validation rules and Swagger API documentation annotations.
